scope: Common legitimate history access plus full-history strong-baseline wiring against LR with the same access. Two already-exposed scripts; no window-summary/R/U=A claim.
split: exposed development; one repeat per arm/case

arm_contracts.full_history: No State controller model calls. Automatically deliver complete real occurred history from public scoped checkpoint interfaces, including assistant final/tool calls/results, plus current actual prefix. Common read_history tool available.
arm_contracts.local_lr_history: Existing LR events-only full-State maintenance and independent A/source view, with the identical common read_history tool. History only through declared runtime access; no observer trace/gold/future access.

shared.full_history_capacity: Existing HostCapacity on entire actual request; no extra full-history byte truncation limit.

history_contract: Runtime indexes only actually visited public turns/sessions under the current run/arm/user, with actual chronological public-turn ordering across sessions.
Read final assistant/tool-call/result objects from public checkpoints, not copied progress answer strings or evaluator logs; current tool loop prefix is not duplicated.
Past capacity-failed prefixes retain actual side effects/status and original messages; do not fabricate completion or ToolMessage to make a chain look complete.

Both arms share the same mechanical cursor/max_bytes read_history tool and whole-record page budget. It extends a new matched tool schema; original answer/calls envelope and native/business tool semantics remain.
Owner-scoped checkpoint gets/logical bytes/CPU/wall and actual model usage charged; no new database or second persistent body archive.

Known tombstone under current owner conservatively suppresses new history tools/projection for that owner, including assistant echoes; other owner unaffected. This is not physical erasure of historical evidence.
Original checkpoints/raw messages retained; projections affect only actual request copies. No use of other-arm history or future script messages.

hypotheses.H1: State maintenance can discard previously available details, while complete legitimate history can recover them when it fits the window; LR benefits must be compared with this strong reference.
hypotheses.H2: Failures may persist despite available original facts because Host rewrites keys or misreads current/past intent; full history may also add distraction and cost. Do not treat history accessibility alone as semantic success.

scoring: Original p1-rubric full12 messages per arm. Preserve exact item_key/destination/packing, real partial receipt/get found/same-id label recovery, other owner isolation, all failures and skipped messages. Mechanism audit uses actual HTTP/State commits/delivery/real actions, not normal exit.
mechanism_checks: Full-history actual HTTP contains complete declared prior observations/assistant/tool chains and current prefix without duplicate turn injection; trace states any suppressed history or capacity failure.
Full_history has no hidden State-control generation; LR retains actual maintenance/A accounting.
Common history tool description/schema and scope/byte rules exactly match across arms; actual tool choices and histories may diverge.
Validate phase restart, current/other owner separation, real partial reservation and same-id read+label recovery, source/HTTP/write/answer chain.
order_rationale: New full_history first; reverse arm order in second script. No result-dependent ordering.
isolation: Fresh run/arm/user State+LangMem namespaces, world/checkpoint/journal; independent phase processes.
source_freeze: Formal prepare only after source and protocol publication; bind actualsource/input/config/dependencies and freeze through all four trajectories.
stop_rule: All semantic/capacity/optional-control failures retain full denominators; stop affected execution on infrastructure/uncaught faults and diagnose before remaining originally planned independent runs. No replay/replacement.
next_decision: Retain four complete planned trajectories and all costs; repair only concrete integration faults. Do not wording-tune old semantic misses. Then implement/evaluate required window-summary and rebuild controls plus remaining scoped ablations/lifecycle/native tasks.

source_checks.pytest_command: uv run --no-sync --group baseline-langmem pytest -q tests/unit/test_local_state_attention.py tests/unit/test_langmem_application.py tests/unit/test_langmem_foundation.py

build.package_contents: sdist CLI and wheel history.py verified
